target_hypothesis: one sigma_B per structural profile transfers across held-out events

calibration_split.rule: estimate sigma_B on a subset spanning at least low and medium source intensity; never tune per event

reject_fixed_sigma_if: systematic intensity-dependent bias remains after one profile-level sigma_B is fixed
systematic antecedent-state bias remains after K/S are derived from state
PF response depends materially on antecedent spatial-moisture variability in a way the fixed-sigma_B/top-state model cannot reproduce
prohibited: retuning connectivity geometry to repair activation errors
